answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by rationing live identity exams. Each new account prepays a fee and is given one unpredictable dawn slot, when a rotating examiner set issues a short interactive task that must be signed by that same key inside a tight window. The transcript is published on a public lantern so later clustering can compare timing, wording, and device traces. A no-show or a detected clone freezes the account in a glacier hold and burns the fee. Mass farming then needs exclusive live slots plus uncorrelated traces, which does not scale.
